# Mission Canvas

> Software built around how your business works, running on your own computers. We audit the workflow, build the application and hand it over. No per-seat fees.

Mission Canvas builds private AI software for small and mid-sized businesses. Each engagement starts with a workflow audit, then the application is built from a working starting point for the industry (a "canvas") and runs on the business's own computers. Licensed per company, with no per-seat fees. Book an audit: https://missioncanvas.ai/audit/

Software shouldn't need a workaround for the workaround.
Every company has them.
The spreadsheet that fixes the CRM.
The manual check that keeps the process from going wrong.
The person everyone asks because the system doesn't tell them what to do.
It's easy to call this "just how we work." It isn't. It's what happens when the software stops matching the business.
You know where the hours go. We build the software around how you actually work, so your team stops making up for it.
How it works

## From the way you work to software you can run, in four to six weeks.
You don't start from a blank page. We have working applications for common business problems, so you don't pay
us to reinvent them.
We call each one a canvas: the workflows, the words and the rules of one industry, already
built. We start from yours, then change it to fit the rules your people follow and the steps your software
never captured.
The starting point is proven. What you end up with is yours.
Four steps, four to six weeks

### Audit
We sit with your team and map how work really moves: the tools, the files, the handoffs. We measure where time goes.
You get Process map · Where the hours go

### Redesign
We cut the steps that only exist to move information from one system to another.
You get The new way of working, on paper

### Assemble
We start from the working application for your industry, change it to fit, and build the parts only you need.
You get Your application, set up

### Operate
The software takes over repeat work: data entry, reports, filing. We measure it and adjust it with your team.
You get Running in your business
Book an audit No contract. Nothing to prepare.

## Questions.
What is Mission Canvas?
Software built around how your business already works, running on your own computers. We audit how the work moves, build the application from a working starting point for your industry, and hand it over to you. Who is it for?
Small and mid-sized businesses whose work runs on documents, records and rules. That includes construction, education, logistics, front desk and voice, events and venues, with healthcare and office work in progress. How is it different from ChatGPT or other AI chat tools?
Chat tools answer questions in someone else's cloud. Mission Canvas builds an application around your workflow and runs it on your computers. The AI works inside it, with your rules and records, and an outside model is used only for the work you allow. What happens in the audit?
We sit with your team and map how the work really moves: the tools, the files, the handoffs. We measure where the time goes. You get a process map and a list of where the hours go. No contract, nothing to prepare. How long does it take?
Four to six weeks from the audit to handover, depending on what the audit finds.

About Mission Canvas

# AI should back up your expertise, not replace it.
We help businesses see, own and improve the work that matters most, with AI they can answer for.
A note from the founder
,

## The team.

### Jason Covington
Fractional CFO, CPO and COO practice.

### Mical Neill
Twelve years in voice and knowledge systems.

### Daniele Mulas
IT, and making things useful to real people.

### Pierfrancesco Borghero
Running development teams.

## What we believe.

### Own your workflows. Don’t rent your intelligence.
What your company knows sits in email, calendars, documents, drives and people’s heads. We connect it on hardware you control.

### You decide what runs where.
Requests run on your machines. You decide what leaves, which AI models are used, and why.

### Work should be visible.
Spreadsheets changed finance. Computer-aided design changed engineering. We want you to see how work flows, and improve it.

## What we’re working toward.
These are outcomes we’re working to prove, not results we claim today.

### Give people their time back
Cut repetitive work, so attention goes to people, ideas and decisions.

### Make AI understandable
Systems you can see into, explain and check. No black boxes.

### Connect what you know
Turn scattered information into something your team can search and share.

### Keep what people know
Capture how work is done before it leaves with someone who retires.

### AI for everyone
Let anyone design a workflow, not only developers and data scientists.

### Work better together
Let teams build, share and improve their workflows together.

### Earn trust
Privacy, security and human oversight first. Technology should earn trust, not demand it.

## Wherever paperwork piles up.
Healthcare is where this matters most. Patient information can’t go into a public AI tool. With Mission
Canvas, sensitive work stays on a local model, and every answer records the path it took.
The same approach works in education, logistics, legal, financial services, government and manufacturing.

## Your company already knows how to work. Your software should too.
Building the tool is a separate job, quoted before you commit. Book an audit
No contract. Nothing to prepare.

Source: https://missioncanvas.ai/apps/

Download

# Download the apps.
Desktop apps for Mac, Windows and Linux. They run on your own computer.

## Palette
Free. Try it on your own files.
Mac Windows Linux

## Education
Education workspace
Mac Windows Linux

## Logistics
Operations control tower
Mac Windows Linux Sample data

## After it downloads.
- Mac Open the.dmg and drag the app into Applications. Palette is signed and notarized.
If macOS still says the app can't be verified, right-click it and choose Open.
- Windows Run the -Setup.exe installer. It is not yet code-signed, so SmartScreen shows
"Windows protected your PC": click More info, then Run anyway.
- Linux Palette is a.deb: open it with your software installer, or run
sudo apt install ~/Downloads/MissionCanvas.deb. The other apps are.AppImage files,
which download without permission to run, so double-clicking does nothing. In a terminal, chmod +x
the file, then run it. On Ubuntu 22.04 or newer, first sudo apt install libfuse2. On Ubuntu 24.04 an
AppImage may quit at once with a "SUID sandbox" error; start it with --no-sandbox.
For developers

## Install the command line.
A terminal build for asking questions against a repository or a folder. It ships on its own release train and is
not the same build as the apps above. Developer docs
macOS / Linux curl -fsSL https://missioncanvas.ai/install-cli.sh | sh
Windows irm https://missioncanvas.ai/install-cli.ps1 | iex

job you'd most like off your plate.

- Where the hours go. The steps that eat the most time, and which ones software can take off your plate.
- A clear next step. What we would build first, and a quote for it if you want one.

Construction and Real Estate

# Construction job costing and fleet software Run the job, not the paperwork.
Job site, office and fleet in one system, with AI doing the back-office work. Built around how your crew already
works, running on your own computers.
Book an audit No contract. Nothing to prepare. Meet Livella

## What it handles today.
These parts work now. Anything else your business needs is agreed in the audit and built for you. This list is
the floor, not the ceiling.
- 01

### Every job site in one record
Status, crews, documents and progress in one place. Each job’s costs run from estimate to actuals and stay current.
- 02

### Delivery tickets read by AI
Inbound and outbound delivery tickets are digitised, read automatically and tied to the right job.
- 03

### Safety and quality without paper
Protective equipment is assigned and declarations stay compliant. Concrete pours and material quality are logged to code.
- 04

### Fleet and fuel
Equipment records, due dates and job-site assignments. Fuel tracked by machine and by job. Scheduled maintenance and driver contracts linked.
- 05

### Crew and hiring
Employee records and roles without spreadsheets. AI screens résumés from application to shortlist.
- 06

### Office paperwork
Mileage reimbursements calculated and printed to PDF. Payments to vendors and employees ordered, tracked and approved. Invoices read automatically.
- 07

### An assistant that knows the business
Answers questions from the firm’s own data. Field notes can be dictated and transcribed automatically.
Meet Livella

## Livella
Job site, office and fleet in one system, with AI doing the back-office work.
Livella is the construction app we start from: a web app for the office and a field app for the site, with
unlimited field users.
Book an audit No contract. Nothing to prepare.
Livella · Job site
↑

## See it on a real job.
Three screens from one day: the job, a delivery ticket, the cost sheet.
Runs every day at an Italian construction firm that pays for it and whose own work it was built around.

## Four to six weeks, start to handover.
What working with us looks like, so you know how much disruption to expect.

### Audit
We walk through how a job moves from the site to the office: notes, delivery tickets, fuel, costs.

### Redesign
We cut the steps where someone retypes the same thing into another system.

### Assemble
We set up Livella around your jobs, your cost codes and your forms.

### Operate
Your crew uses it on live jobs. We adjust it with you as it runs.

## Your job files stay on your computer.
- Files are read and organized on a computer you already own. No data migration. No new cloud account.
- If you use an outside AI model, only what that task needs is sent, and it's logged.
- You can run local models instead, and send nothing out. How we handle your data

Canvases CV-01 Education

# Private AI for schools A living picture of every student, on your own machines.
Say or type what you noticed in under a minute. The right student’s lens updates: strategies that work, accommodations, CEFR milestones. Student data never leaves the school.
Book an audit No contract. Nothing to prepare.

## What it handles today.
These parts work now. Anything else your business needs is agreed in the audit and built for you. This list is the floor, not the ceiling.
- 01

### Student and classroom lenses
A learning profile for each student and each class that keeps growing across grades and teachers.
- 02

### Progress notes and IEPs
Bring in a note that covers several students. Each student gets only their own part, with a confidence badge.
- 03

### Summaries for parents
Drafted only from confirmed lens entries. Nothing goes home until every sentence traces back to one.
- 04

### Exercises from your coursework
Activities adapted from the school’s own coursework and textbooks, in three tiers.

## See it on a real day.
A recording of the shipped build, unedited.
Education · recording ↑ Recorded 21 September 2026 on version 0.2.106, unedited: roster import, a report card into the lenses, an observation, a summary and a three-tier activity. The class is a sample.
Tested against live data · Runs on your own computers · Handed over in four to six weeks
Everything it already does: 8 modules, 42 features
- M-01 Students A lens per student, built from what the school already writes down.
- M-02 Observe A short note, attached to the right child, in under a minute.
- M-03 Assess Language work reviewed, not graded by a machine.
- M-04 Prepare and Plan Lessons from the coursework the teacher already has.
- M-05 Summaries What goes home is checked before it goes.
- M-06 Ask Questions answered on the machine, and it says so.
- M-07 Governance and privacy The verdict is computed from the log, not asserted.
- M-08 Coordinator views The school, seen across classrooms.

Canvases CV-07 Office & Administration In progress

# Invoice processing automation for small businesses Invoices read, checked and filed.
The repetitive back-office work, done on your own computers.
Book an audit No contract. Nothing to prepare.

## What it is being built around.
This canvas is in progress, so these are what it is being built around, not finished features. There are no screenshots yet.
- 01

### Invoices
Extracted from what arrives, checked, and filed in the right place.
- 02

### Queries
Questions about an invoice or a payment answered from the record.
- 03

### Recurring work

Questions

# Asked before every audit.
If yours is not here, ask it in the audit, or write to us from the audit page.

## The basics
What is Mission Canvas?
Software built around how your business already works, running on your own computers. We audit how the work moves, build the application from a working starting point for your industry, and hand it over to you. Who is it for?
Small and mid-sized businesses whose work runs on documents, records and rules. That includes construction, education, logistics, front desk and voice, events and venues, with healthcare and office work in progress. How is it different from ChatGPT or other AI chat tools?
Chat tools answer questions in someone else's cloud. Mission Canvas builds an application around your workflow and runs it on your computers. The AI works inside it, with your rules and records, and an outside model is used only for the work you allow. What happens in the audit?
We sit with your team and map how the work really moves: the tools, the files, the handoffs. We measure where the time goes. You get a process map and a list of where the hours go. No contract, nothing to prepare. How long does it take?
Four to six weeks from the audit to handover, depending on what the audit finds. What is a canvas?
A working application for one industry: its workflows, its words and its rules, already built. We start from yours and change it to fit, so you do not pay for what already exists.

## Cost and ownership
What does it cost?
One license per company, plus services quoted before you commit. Never per seat, no per-token charges, and no subscription for the application we hand over. The audit itself costs. Who owns what you build?
You do. The application is handed over to run on your hardware. What if we stop working together?
The application keeps running on your machines.

## Your data and your systems
Does our data leave our computers?
Your files are read on a computer you already own. Sensitive work stays on local models. Anything sent to an outside model is screened for personal information first, and every decision is logged. You decide what, if anything, goes out. Do we need new hardware?
No. A workstation or a server you already own is enough. No data migration, no new cloud account. Can we keep the tools we use today?
Yes. It starts from the files, exports and records you already have. The logistics canvas, for example, imports CSV, Excel, Monday.com and HubSpot. What is Palette?
Our free desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux. It runs local AI on your own files, one folder at a time, and every claim in what it writes links back to its source.

## Do what you do best. We'll handle the software.
Building the tool is a separate job, quoted before you commit. Book an audit
No contract. Nothing to prepare.

Source: https://missioncanvas.ai/how-it-works

How it works

# From scattered files to one picture of your business.
Four steps turn what your company already has into something AI can work with. All of it on your own computers.
Book an audit No contract. Nothing to prepare.

## The four steps, in one painting
01 · Read

### Start with what you have.
Files, exports and records, read on your own machines. Nothing to move, nothing to retype.
You get
A private index of what your company knows 02 · Sort

### Work out what each file is about.
It finds the people, customers, orders, documents, processes and equipment behind the files.
You get
The things your business is made of 03 · Connect

### See how it all fits together.
It links those things into one picture of how your company works, so the AI gets the connections, not just loose text.
You get
One connected map of your company 04 · Work

### Put that knowledge to work.
AI workers, called agents, use the map inside your walls. If an outside model is needed, only what the task needs is sent.
You get
Context for agents and for your industry’s application
- 01 Read
- 02 Sort
- 03 Connect
- 04 Work
Follow one example

## One customer, one order, one contract.
Here is what each step does to three ordinary files. We call the result a private map of your company: the things in it, and how they connect.
- Read

### Start with what you have.
It starts with the material your team already uses. Everything is indexed on your own computers, so there is a base to work from.
Example A customer record, an order export and a signed contract.
- Sort

### Work out what each file is about.
A file is just a container. A customer or an order is something your business understands. This step finds those things across all your files.
Example The customer, the order and the contract become three separate things it knows about.
- Connect

### See how it all fits together.
Connections turn separate facts into context: who looks after a customer, what an order needs, which document describes a piece of equipment.
Example A customer places an order. That order points to a contract.
- Work

### Put that knowledge to work.
The map becomes the base for your application and its agents. The AI model can run locally or outside; the map stays yours.
Example An agent follows the order’s links to find the right customer and contract.
Working with us

## Four to six weeks, start to handover.
We start from a canvas: a working application for your industry, with its workflows, words and
rules already built. Then we change it to fit you.

### Audit
We sit with your team and map how work really moves: the tools, the files, the handoffs. We measure where time goes.
You get Process map · Where the hours go

### Redesign
We cut the steps that only exist to move information from one system to another.
You get The new way of working, on paper

### Assemble
We start from the working application for your industry, change it to fit, and build the parts only you need.
You get Your application, set up

### Operate
The software takes over repeat work: data entry, reports, filing. We measure it and adjust it with your team.
You get Running in your business
Then the AI goes to work

## Ask it about your work. It answers from your records.
One real exchange in the shipped Logistics canvas, on sample orders. The AI works inside the application, with your
rules and your data, and shows where every answer came from.
01 Ask in plain words "Where is REF-7100?" The answer gives the stage, owner, carrier and tracking number, with the records it came from listed underneath. 02 It keeps the thread "Tell me about them," then "show their late orders." Customer data is marked local-only on every answer. 03 It says no when it should A question it cannot classify gets "unknown", stays on the machine, and is blocked from going to an outside model.

Mission Canvas Palette

# The free local AI app for your documents: Palette
It asks first. Then it shows its work.
A free app for your computer. Give it one folder. It lists what is there without opening a file, reads only what
you allow, and builds a document from the facts you accept. Every line leads back to the sentence it came from.
Mac Windows Linux
Palette runs on a computer.
Send yourself this page
and open it there.
Free. No account. Version 0.4.1, released 15 October 2026. Mac is signed and notarised. Windows is not yet
signed, so SmartScreen will warn you once: what to click, and how to check the file.
The design we are building toward. The app as it ships today is below, screen by screen.
See it work · 105 seconds, unedited

## Ask, change, read it back.
One take on the sample notes: a spoken request finds nineteen facts and the document appears; a spoken change and
a clicked one each become a new version; then it reads the document aloud in a voice that runs on the machine.
Recorded 21 September 2026 on a build of 0.3.8 with the two changes that shipped in 0.3.9: the note bar sits at
the bottom, and spoken requests apply without a confirm card.
Download the recording, 5 MB
The rules it keeps · each one can be checked in the app
Most AI apps tell you what they will do for you. This one is easier to describe by what it will not do without you.
- 01

### It never goes looking.
It works on the folders you hand it, one at a time. It does not search the rest of the computer on its own.
- 02

### It reads nothing until you say so.
Listing a folder opens no file. Reading starts when you press Grant, and every file it read is listed afterwards.
- 03

### Nothing in the document is made up.
Today the document is the facts you accepted, in a fixed layout. If a fact is not in your notes, it is not in the document. Written summaries come next, held to the same rule: every sentence leads back to a source.
- 04

### Nothing it keeps is hidden.
On Home, what you asked for is kept and listed on screen in the same turn, and every version of the document is kept. In a matter, your words wait on a card until you keep them.
- 05

### It does not need a model to work.
The sample runs with no AI model installed and no key. The app says so on screen.
- 06

### It keeps a list of what it connects to.
The app keeps a list of the connections it has made. On a fresh install, after the whole sample, that list reads “none yet”.
The first five minutes · screens from version 0.3.7, not drawings

## What you will see, in the order you will see it.
These are the app's own screens, taken from version 0.3.7 running the sample notes. Since then the note bar has
moved to the bottom, and requests on Home no longer wait on a card. The steps are the same, and they run on your
own folder.
- 01 It opens empty, with one button Nothing to set up and no account. “Try it with sample notes” places four invented notes in the app’s own folder, so you can see the whole thing work before it touches anything of yours.
- 02 It shows you a folder before it reads it Names and counts only. No file is opened to make this list. It says what it would read, what it would skip and why, and waits for you to grant the folder.
- 03 You say what you want. It asks before keeping anything Type it or hold the mic. It finds the facts in the notes you granted and holds them on a card. On Home in 0.3.9 it keeps them in the same turn and lists what it kept.
- 04 The document is the facts you accepted Today it is a template, filled in, so there is no sentence in it that nobody wrote. The panel on the right says which model wrote the draft: none.
- 05 Every line leads back to its sentence Each claim sits beside the words it came from and the file they are in. Nineteen claims, nineteen sources.
- 06 Click a value to change it Or say the change out loud. It shows the change on a card, you confirm, and the document becomes version 2. Version 1 is kept.

Nineteen claims, nineteen sources. Click a value to change it Or say the change out loud. It shows the change on a card, you confirm, and the document becomes version 2. Version 1 is kept.
What it is for, and what it is not

## Good for
- A review, brief or summary sheet assembled from scattered notes
- Finding out where a number in a document came from
- Seeing what is in a folder before anything is allowed to read it
- Work where a wrong sentence is expensive

## Not for
- Searching the web
- Your inbox or your calendar
- Booking, buying or doing errands
- Free writing: emails, essays, posts
Today It reads plain text:.txt,.md,.csv,.json
and.ics. PDFs and Office files are listed and skipped, and it tells you so. It is an early build, and it
is honest about where it stops.
Install · version 0.4.1 · 15 October 2026
- Mac
Open MissionCanvas.dmg and drag the app into Applications. It is signed and notarised. If macOS still says it cannot be verified, right-click the app and choose Open. Download for Mac, 683 MB
- Windows
Run MissionCanvas-Setup.exe. The installer is not yet code-signed, so SmartScreen shows “Windows protected your PC”. Click More info, then Run anyway. If you would rather check the file first, its SHA-256 is below. Download for Windows, 637 MB
- Linux
Open MissionCanvas.deb with your software installer, or run sudo apt install ~/Downloads/MissionCanvas.deb. Download for Linux, 701 MB
The files are still named MissionCanvas. They are Palette. SHA-256: check the file you downloaded

are the digests GitHub publishes for release desktop-v0.4.1; this page reads them when it is built.

Last updated October 14, 2026 · Draft

# Your data, in plain words.
Keeping your information on your own computers is the whole idea behind Mission Canvas. Here is exactly what
this website and our software do with it.

## What this website collects
- Nothing stored on the site. The audit forms open an email in your own mail program. We only
receive what you choose to send.
- No cookies and no tracking. This site sets no cookies and runs no analytics today. If we add
visitor counts, they will be cookie-free, hosted by us, and listed on this page first.
- Booking a time. When you pick an audit time, the booking tool
keeps your name, email and the time you chose so it can send the invite.

## Why we collect it
Only to set up and run your audit, and to follow up about it. We don't sell it, rent it or use it for
advertising.

## Your email stays with your email provider
Mission Canvas does not bring your company's email into an inbox of ours. When your application automates
email work, it is set up inside the provider you already use: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or any IMAP and
SMTP service. Your correspondence stays inside your own security boundaries.

## How our software handles your business files
- Your files are read and organized on your own computer.
- If you use a cloud AI model, only the minimum context for that task is sent to it.
- You can run local models instead, so nothing is sent at all.

## Questions or deletion requests
Email jason.covington@missioncanvas.ai and we'll answer within.

---

Source: https://missioncanvas.ai/security

Your data

# Your files stay on your computers.
What is read locally, what may leave, and how every decision is recorded. Said plainly, with nothing claimed that is not true today.
Your data

## Your files stay on your computers.
The application runs on hardware you control. It checks every request before the AI works on it. Sensitive work
stays on your machine, and every decision is logged.

### Read
It reads what you already have.
Files, exports and records, on your own machines. No migration.

### Sort
It finds what your business is made of.
Customers, orders, documents, people, equipment and processes, in whatever format they were left.

### Connect
It links them into one picture.
Your files, jobs and costs, connected in one place that stays on your machine.

### Work
The AI works from that picture.
Not from a pile of text. Outside models are called only when needed, with the least information possible.

### Runs on your hardware
A workstation or server you already own. No data migration. No new cloud account.

### Local models first
The AI runs on your own machine. You choose which work, if any, goes to an outside model.

### Checked before it leaves
Anything sent outside is screened for personal information first. Every decision is logged.

### Locked by default
A firewall inside the app controls what can leave. If it cannot be enforced, the app does not start.
Why this matters now
In February 2026 a federal court held that a defendant's exchanges with a public AI platform were neither privileged nor work product. United States v. Heppner, S.D.N.Y., February 2026
A proposed update to the HIPAA Security Rule would require documented evidence behind decisions touching
protected health information. It is not final. Mission Canvas already records the path of every request,
with nothing to set up.
HIPAA Security Rule NPRM, published January 2025; final action not yet taken
The design is ours and patented: a request is classified before any model runs, and nothing later can reopen that
decision. We didn't patent the classifier. We patented the rule that makes classifying first mean something.

## Questions about data.
Does our data leave our computers?
Your files are read on a computer you already own. Sensitive work stays on local models. Anything sent to an outside model is screened for personal information first, and every decision is logged. You decide what, if anything, goes out. Do we need new hardware?
No. A workstation or a server you already own is enough. No data migration, no new cloud account. Can we keep the tools we use today?
Yes. It starts from the files, exports and records you already have. The logistics canvas, for example, imports CSV, Excel, Monday.com and HubSpot.
For how this website and the audit handle your details, read the privacy page.

## Do what you do best. We'll handle the software.
Building the tool is a separate job, quoted before you commit. Book an audit
No contract. Nothing to prepare.

What is Mission Canvas

# Software built around how your business works.

industry, runs it on your own computers, and hands it over.

Why Mission Canvas

# Your business already knows what it needs to know.
It's just scattered across drives, inboxes, spreadsheets, systems and people. We put it in order, on your own
computers, and build the software that works with it.

## Scattered files
Years of documents, exports and scans that nobody can search as one.

## Systems that don’t talk
Accounting, job software, spreadsheets and email each hold a piece. None holds the whole.

## Copying by hand
People carry information between tools by hand. That is where time and accuracy go.

## How we differ from enterprise AI search.
